name: ConfirmDialog
description: Accessible confirmation dialog with async pending state, destructive variant and cancellable actions, built on Dialog.
designIntent: Confirmations are copy-pasted per project (79 hand-rolled modals in the audited apps), usually without focus trapping or Escape. ConfirmDialog provides the accessible default plus a pending state for async actions.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Red confirm button for destructive actions.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Confirm handler; a promise shows a pending state.

props.name: closeOnConfirm
props.description: Close when the confirm handler resolves.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra body content above the actions.

examples.title: Delete confirmation
examples.code:
<ConfirmDialog
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  title="Delete project"
  description="This cannot be undone."
  destructive
  confirmLabel="Delete"
  onConfirm={deleteProject}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for multi-field forms
antiPatterns.explanation: ConfirmDialog is a yes/no gate; richer flows belong in Dialog.

accessibility.implementation: Inherits Dialog's focus trap, Escape, backdrop and focus restoration
Confirm shows aria-busy while the promise runs; dismissal is blocked
accessibility.userRequirements: Return a promise for async actions

compositionRules.relationship: Built on Dialog; use Dialog directly for custom layouts
